rationale: New Imperativ box from the clear stick-preparation command. Edition German only summarizes the advice and supplies no aligned translation of this command; translation is null, not silently reconstructed.

summary: Both occurrences retain I 1 glätten. The stick is explicit at the start of the command and resumed by -e in mlase; bi skino is the instrument.
mlase is Imperativ, contrasting with finite mləsle in the next verse. No new sense or etymology is required by the sexual use of the prepared stick.
The edition German abridges the explicit Turoyo instructions to a good-advice summary and its execution to Er befolgte denselben. Neither paraphrase is published as an aligned translation of mlase.
The new Imperativ attestation is therefore supplied with translation null and an explicit human-reading notice. The inherited Preterit and its editorial translation warning are preserved.
